business.name: Nona’s Urban Pizza
business.googleAiSummary: People say this pizza shop offers delicious and unique pizzas like the Tripleta and Jibara, along with tasty garlic knots and lasagna. They also highlight the lively atmosphere, pinball machines, and good value. Some reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
business.brandNotes: Family-owned and operated pizzeria located in Lake Nona Landing (Orlando, FL). Connected to the team behind El Cilantrillo. Known for combining classic New York / Italian-style thin-crust pizzas, calzones, strombolis, wings, and pastas with bold Caribbean, Puerto Rican, and Dominican fusion specialty pizzas (such as the Tripleta Pizza, Domi Pizza, Jíbara Pizza, and Urban Burger Pizza).

overviewFeaturedQuotes.quote: Excellent service, super clean restaurant with fantastic food….
Excellent thin crust style pizza with fresh ingredients and a great sauce.
Red wine tasted spoiled, moldy I guess from dirty lines.

reviews.author: Ivette Pellot
reviews.text:
We’ve been wanting to try this place since we love El Cilantrillo, so we made the almost 2-hour drive—and the food did not disappoint. The garlic knots and sampler appetizers were so good, the meat lasagna was amazing, and the tripleta pizza was really good too. We also tried a calzone, which was just okay.

I’m giving it 4 stars because the cleanliness needs improvement. The floor was very sticky, and the women’s bathroom was dirty. Also, the staff could be more welcoming—only the guy making the pizza greeted us with a smile, while the rest didn’t seem too friendly.

reviews.author: Rameci Rivera
reviews.text: Visit this place since we’ve seen so many videos and it didn’t disappoint, pizza was hot, cheesy and toasty= perfection just like the garlic knots they were delicious. Place does get busy if you don’t want to wait I would suggest calling ahead of time.

reviews.author: Yamir Morales
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Nonas Urban Pizza in Orlando is absolutely amazing! From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming — modern yet cozy, perfect for any occasion. The pizza is next-level — fresh ingredients, perfectly crispy crust, and flavor combinations that make every bite unforgettable. You can really taste the quality and care that goes into their food.

The staff is super friendly and attentive, making sure you have everything you need without ever feeling rushed. Whether you’re dining in or grabbing takeout, the service is always top-notch.

If you’re in Orlando and craving incredible pizza, Nonas Urban Pizza is the spot. 100% recommend — you’ll definitely be back for more! 🍕🔥

reviews.author: Geraldine Giselle
reviews.text:
This place is mid at best. Didn’t realize that they don’t put tomatoes on the margarita pizza so I received a cheese pizza with a piece of basil on it. It wasn’t bad, it just wasn’t anything special and I was underwhelmed. The staff looked like they hated their job and everyone was a huge inconvenience. The guy that took our order didn’t even speak or smile. It was awkward. I understand why this place is empty.
I would have rated lower but restaurants can take down 1 stars easily so I had to put 2 stars.

reviews.author: Brigida H
reviews.text:
1st time trying and wow, the pizza is so good.  We had the tripleta and Domi and it was beyond our expectations.  Though I wish they had more seating, the dining area was nice and played good music. Eli working the dining area was top tier on customer service!  Always helpful, attentive,  and never far if you needed something. Great young man, good job hiring that one.

We will def be back again. To try more types or if anything definitely the Domi/tripleta

reviews.author: Cris Orlando
reviews.text: The pizza sauce was delicious and had a lot of cheese. The dough was a little too soft right of the oven so let the pizza cool off before you grab a slice.  The staff is nice and the atmosphere is pretty chill. The TVs are great!

reviews.author: Rosangela Marrero
reviews.text: We love the food it was amazing. The triplets and the domi super good. The appetizer was really good too.

reviews.author: Cedric James
reviews.text: This place is amazing and gives you alot of amazing choices. For the military and veterans they got your back with discounts.
